goal: Let users attach bitcoin-gui to a running background node rather than spawning a new subprocess each time
Allow opening and closing the GUI interface independently of the underlying daemon
agreement: General interest in independent GUI sessions, but with nonblocking crash reports
Concept approval of the -ipcconnect option name and interface (laanwj, meshcollider)
Verified remote GUI connection over an SSH Unix socket tunnel (Sjors)
Nonblocking objection: GUI assertion failure with external signers or PSBTs over IPC (Sjors)
Nonblocking objection: node crash when GUI connects without -disablewallet to a walletless node (jimhashhq)
